notes.title: Patch Notes - 5th December 2024
notes.content:
Patch Notes - 5th December 2024

New Content & Features & Reworks

 Added basic Sound/Audio implementation:

 Added background music for title screen and each in-game zone
 Added some minor SFX (button click, forge user, sale to merchant etc.)
 Added audio/sound effects for Warrior's Basic and Core abilities (will add Utility/Aura/Curse and other classes at a future time)
 Added audio for player movement
 Added enemy basic attack and abilitity sound effects
 Added sliders to adjust various sounds in the settings menu
 Please note that this is a relatively basic implementation and the sounds will be updated/improved/expanded upon over time

 Added two new unique items for 'Final Judgement' Warrior ability: Divine Justice and The King's Judgement

notes.title: Patch Notes - 14th November 2024
notes.content:
Sorry for the hiatus! I'm back to active development!

Here are the latest patch notes:

New Content & Features & Reworks

 Added a classic ARPG Map overlay, openable with 'TAB' and 'M'. As part of this work, the side minimap has also been significantly reworked. Make sure to test those out as they are a pretty big change.
 Added two new unique items to support 'Debilitating Shout'.

Miscellaneous & Small Changes

 Update Godot engine to version 4.3. Carries some performance improvements and new functionality.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the 'Enemies in zone' was not updated when new enemies were spawned in the zone (e.g. via Monster Totem).


Focus for next patch

 Settings Menu

notes.title: Patch Notes - 6th June 2024
notes.content:
New Content & Features & Reworks

 Added a 10 second grace period on zone changes/respawn
 Added 'Mana Shield' ability for Mage. A toggleable ability which when active makes the player take damage from mana pool instead of health pool.
 Added 2 new unique items - Celestial Aegis and Manaflow Band, both as support for the Mana Shield ability (screenshots below)


Miscellaneous & Small Changes

 Added the ability to double-click a saved game to immediately load it from the load menu
 Added a new tutorial for selecting basic attacks (screenshot below). Additionally, whenever a 'Basic Attack' is assigned, it will now automatically become the active selected basic attack.
 Re-worked 'Character Creation Panel' & added background/summary for each class
 Re-worked the 'Forge' UI. Still far from how I'd ideally like it to look/function but it will do for now. Resolves the problem of Item Preview cutting off at the bottom of the screen when in the Forge. (Updated UI in screenshot below)
 Updated 'Quest Reward Pop-up' styling
 Updated styling of active Buff/Debuff Icons and Descriptions (top left/right of the screen)


Bug Fixes

 Resolved an issue with z-index of Toggleable abilities with a visual effect (Whilrwind, Pyromaniac). They will no longer appear over every single UI element whilst active.
 Resolved an issue where Whirlwind direction would be saved between Whirlwinds, resulting in unnatural spinning patterns.


Focus for next patch

 Review all class abilities and rework any that are not fit for purpose/do not feel good (mostly Ranger class)

Focus for next patch

 Improvements to Gemstones/Forge UI in preparation for Devlog #2 which will focus on crafting

notes.title: Patch Notes - 23rd May 2024
notes.content:
New Content & Features & Reworks

 Added 'Reforger' NPC. Can be found in Nilehaven. The Reforger functions similarly to an Enchanter in Diablo series. Few notes about reforging: 
[olist]
 Reforged items can no longer be crafted with gemstones. This means that reforging is intended to be used either to slightly improve a random item off the ground that you wouldn't otherwise waste gemstones on, or as the final part of crafting a BiS item once it's been fully crafted with gemstones.
 The Reforge/Augment button can be triggered by pressing 'Space'
 Once an item has been reforged once, only the reforged modifier can be re-reforged, basically locking all other modifiers in place.
[/olist]
 Added 2 new unique items: The Slammer and Lifeline Grips, providing unique effects to the Warrior 'Shield Slam' ability. Screenshots of them can be found at the bottom of this post.


Miscellaneous & Small Changes

 Added/Replaced 4 Amulet sprites
 All Gemstones in a zone are now 'hoovered' on click just like gold


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the player to 'click through' the inventory and move-click instead of moving items in the inventory


Focus for next patch

 Preparing the game for Devlog #1, i.e. first 10-20 minutes of gameplay. Cleaning up some UIs, Sprites etc.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 19th May 2024
notes.content:
New Content & Features & Big reworks

 Added 4 new modifiers: increased_basic_attack_damage, reduced_basic_attack_cooldown, bleed_applied_multiplier, ignite_applied_multiplier. 
Note: The way bleed and ignite work is by applying a bleed/ignite damage equivalent to the damage whatever applies it. For example, if a hit with 'Heavy Strike' deals 500 damage and subsequently triggers a bleed application, a 500 bleed will be applied on the enemy. The new modifiers allow for scaling this application. A 120% bleed_applied_modifier would result in 600 bleed being applied in the above scenario.
 Added 7 new unique items focusing on basic attacks (images can be found at the bottom of the post): Cleaver's Stride, Cleavestrike Helm, The Essence of Simplicity, Ring of Fervor, Neurotoxin Edge, Bloodlust, Earthshaker
 Rebalanced/Reworked 'Thorns'. Instead of uniquely handled flat damage effect, Thorns is now considered a regular 'Physical' attack and so benefits from any relevant modifiers (e.g. damage against close, increased physical damage etc.). To compensate, Thorns values have been lowered across the board. In practice this will make Thorns weaker early game but allow for it to be a viable build much later into the game.
 Bleed and Ignite avoid attributes have been reworked. Previously, a 50% bleed avoid attribute meant that for a 500 bleed application, 50% of the time you would have 0 bleed applied, and 50% of the time you would have 500 (100%) of the bleed applied. Now, a 50% bleed avoid would result in you always having 250 bleed applied.


Miscellaneous & Small Changes

 Item Preview Detailed view is now toggled while 'Alt' is held (aligning with industry standard)
 Added ability to drop item directly on the floor from inventory by clicking 'Ctrl' + Left-click
 Scaled down the 'Ghost' enemy sprite
 Reduced opacity of 'Poison Cloud' effect
 Reworked the way damaging elemental effects (bleed, ignite) are applied in the code
 Remove default elemental resistance level scaling for enemies. Now rare enemies have 20 elemental resistance, magic enemies have 10 elemental resistance, normal enemies have 0 elemental resistance
 Minor tweaks to wall tiles in 'Forgotten Tomb' zone
 Refactored Player class to simplify the code. Shouldn't have any impact but please notify in case of any unusual Player behaviour.
 Added a 'close' button to UIs: Quest Log, Character Sheet, Forge, Inventory and Merchant Menu
 Reduced the value/rolls of 'poison_avoid' modifiers across the board - you're not supposed to be able to get 100% poison avoidance without extremely heavy investment
 Improvements to 'gemstone preview' (aligning it to item preview UI design)
 Disabled Damage Labels on Player Events


Bug Fixes

 Fixed being able to move-click through merchant menu
 Fixed issue with item sprite sizes when equipped
 Fixed issue with inventory manager not being properly reset when switching between characters. This resulted in unintended inventory behaviour, e.g. not being able to purchase items
 Fixed a bug with 'Muddy Ground' effect (currently only used by Noxious the Decayed) that could result in Muddy Ground never disappearing


Focus for next patch

 UI improvements
 Enchanter NPC

notes.title: Patch Notes - 13th May 2024
notes.content:
New Content & Features

 Added a new NPC. The Merchant can be found in Nilehaven, next to the Stash. It combines two functions - a seller/gambler similar to gamblers in Diablo2, and also as a buyer, who will buy all items from you. Gambling is currently set at 1 gold to and all gambled items have item level of 99 and required level of 1 to assist with testing 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015432/175006eae4c10b2a3bd70e841fc5b11b71918b66.png

Miscellaneous & Small Changes

 Added a 'spawn in' VFX effect for enemies (e.g. when spawned by Monster Totem or summoned by Noxshade the Decayed) so they no longer just instantly appear out of thin air
 Added 4 new Quiver sprites, replacing some of the old ones
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015432/17c12770af21789c09c55079df251322ea89025d.png
 Enemies now spawn-in 'Disabled' when a zone is entered. They 'Activate' only when they become visible to the Player on screen. Will slightly improve performance
 Simplified/updated the background sprite when viewing/hovering a sign 
 Small Tweaks around the way Tilemap Layers/Z-index works and is resolved. More work necessary in the future. For now, wide enemies (1.5 tiles+, e.g. 'Ghost') will visually clip in eastern and western facing walls



Bug Fixes

 Resolved a bug where extra content (e.g. Vanishing Chest) could spawn on the same exact tile as an enemy and in effect become untargetable
 Resolved a bug with orphaned enemy nodes not being removed, which during long play sessions would result in a memory leak
 Resolved an issue with south-facing walls in 'Forgotten Tomb' where heads of tall enemies (1.5 tiles+) would visually disappear behind the wall


Focus for next patch

 UI/UX improvements
 Enchanter NPC (Similar to Diablo 3/4, the NPC will re-roll a selected modifier on an item)

notes.title: Patch Notes - 11th May 2024
notes.content:
New Content & Features

 Added the first Talus Boss - 'Noxshade the Decayed', he can be found at the Forgotten Tomb Crypt, under the Oasis. He specializes in poison type attacks so be sure to get some poison resistance before facing him.
 4 new regular enemies have been added to the game: Cultist, Ghost, Mummy, Ghoul
 Added 3 three new uniques as exclusive drops from Noxhsade.
[olist]
 Plaguebringer's Horns, a Mage helmet
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015432/5fe51252447608278b1e79c7ff7cb79ede53a2f7.png
 Serpent's Touch, Ranger gloves
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015432/65207be4c0c91b74ee5db669b6e74cd5cad1c390.png
 Noxious Breastplate, a Warrior chest
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015432/f59c97219f6457cd5d2df756801c9603b824417f.png
[/olist]

Miscellaneous & Small Changes

 Added support for boss-exclusive unique drops, i.e. unique items that cannot drop from any other source than a particular Boss. Existing uniques 'Fume Fortress', 'Noxious Band' and 'Venom Step' are now exclusive drops of Noxshade the Decayed.
 Added an explanation about aura limits to each aura description
 Added new VFX for undead splatter when taking damage
 Added a new enemy tier - 'Uniques', you can think of them as stronger regular enemies, usually appearing as part of questlines
 Enemies will now face towards the player after moving around him
 Reworked the way enemy basic attacks apply status effects
 Updated sprites for the following enemies: Skeleton, Skeleton Mage, Skeleton Archer
 Updated Haemorrhage sprite
 Updated Default 'Buff' VFX effect (e.g. when using Haste, Cleanse, Recovery etc.)
 The Basic and Active skill select menus are now automatically closed/hidden when player clicks elsewhere

Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue with debuff timers, they will no longer start at 80% of the timer value
 No longer draw a 'Damage Taken Label' when the effective damage taken is 0

Focus for next patch

 Continue Act1 development
 Work on Enchanter NPC
 Work on Trader NPC
